summary: Retest of iteration-2 fixes. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass (tests/test_iter3_fixes.py), run on a new TEST_it3 user. FIX 1: POST /shopping/share/revoke returns 200, after which the old token gives 404, and the UI share-revoke-button closes the sheet with no page errors. FIX 2: background pricing filled Walmart and No Frills prices for every new item (manual add, craving with a date, manual meal, to-shopping) within about 30s. It also backfilled the old unpriced items on the TEST_ui account once a to-shopping call triggered it. FIX 3: 'Fresh Garlic' went from '4 cloves + 5 cloves' to '9 cloves (buy 3-bulb pack)'; 'Garlic powder' and 'Extra firm tofu' were also combined cleanly. FIX 4: the 'creamy chicken curry' craving returned '20-Minute Creamy Coconut Chicken Curry'. FIX 5: the List button shows 'Already covered — everything is in your pantry or on your list.' on the second tap; the nutrition estimate returns floats; the plan sheet shows 'Starts Wed Nov 25 2026' in full. Regression: the Plan day view has 4 sections with Add buttons, and Accept/Decline are 40x40 with hitSlop 4. 'I ate this' says 'Added 315 kcal', then 'Updated' on the second tap, with no duplicate log. The shopping detail sheet shows the 3-store price comparison. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: Pricing only runs after an add event. Items added before the fix stay unpriced (the TEST_ui list showed $0 for 10 of 14 items until a to-shopping call ran). Store totals and budget are understated until then.

The log is saved to the recipe's planned date (r.date, for example a future Fri Nov 27). The UI copy says 'Adds only your portion to today's nutrition', so the copy and the behaviour disagree. Future meals can also be logged as eaten.

Duplicate check only looks at the matched item's needed_for. Banana Oat Pancakes already had 'Large Flake Oats' (from plan generation); tapping List merged the recipe's oats into 'Rolled Oats' too and reported 'Added 1 item(s)'. The same recipe now needs oats twice.
Manual add never merges. Adding 'Honey' when 'Honey' is already on the list creates a second row.
Ingredient strings are not parsed: '300 g chicken breast' becomes a shopping item with that full name and an empty quantity, so it can't merge with 'Chicken breast'.
The regex skips 'salt and pepper' but not 'Salt and Black Pepper', so that item was added to the shopping list.
todo includes every item with more than one needed_for on every pass, so all merged items are re-priced on every add. This wastes AI calls.

ui_bugs.issue: The revoke onPress uses an empty catch {} and closes the sheet even if the request fails, so the user is never told that revoke failed.

issues: The 'Starts …' text sits about 16px above the bottom edge on a 375x667 viewport with no bottom safe-area padding. It may be clipped on devices with a home indicator.

action_items: Call schedule_pricing from GET /shopping (or at startup) when any unchecked item is missing a store price, so old lists get backfilled.
Either log 'I ate this' to today, or change the copy to say the planned day; consider blocking eat for future dates.
In recipe_to_shop, skip an ingredient if any shopping item already lists this recipe_id in needed_for under a similar name (oats / large flake oats).
Make POST /shopping go through merge_shopping so manual adds merge with existing items.
Parse quantity from ingredient strings in the no-AI manual meal path.
Widen the staple regex (salt and black pepper, sea salt, etc.).
In price_items, only re-price multi-need items when needed_for has changed since the last pass (for example, track a priced_needs count).
Show an error state when share revoke fails.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1606 lines; split it into modules (shopping, plans, nutrition, share).
The PRICING dict is in-memory per process. That is fine for 1 worker, but with multiple workers you get duplicate passes, and pending passes are lost on restart.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested flows (share/revoke, detail sheet, plan day view, plan sheet, recipe List/I ate this)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_it3_* users (shopping items cleaned up; generated recipes remain). On TEST_ui_8ccc88: the List tap merged Banana Oat Pancakes into 'Rolled Oats'; the 'I ate this' log was created then deleted (points from it may remain); a 'Honey' duplicate was added then deleted; the triggered pricing pass priced and normalised that account's existing items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. Pricing finishes about 20-40s after an add. TEST_ui_8ccc88 now has a fully priced list with 3 stores (Walmart, No Frills, Costco). /calendar/range takes start and end. Plan Accept/Decline testIDs are '<card>-accept' / '<card>-decline'.
rca_of_issue: Unpriced old items: schedule_pricing is only called from POST /shopping, recipe_to_shop and plan completion, never on read, so lists created before the fix stay unpriced until the next add.
